facts: Fixed-S128 aggregate metrics were inspected for MIC anchors T5, T10, T15, T20, and T25.
The certified Original fixed-S128 five-anchor curve was inspected for comparison.
Evaluation infrastructure was repaired after observing entry failures, although no MIC retraining followed the revealed task metrics in the recorded run.
Regardless of whether a particular repair changed scientific hyperparameters, this exposure disqualifies S128 as a blind final test for subsequent claims.
allowed_claim: paired descriptive development-benchmark evidence for the frozen single-seed run

next_test.design: Before revealing any new outputs, an independent operator must freeze a content-hash-deduplicated set disjoint from actor training, critic fitting, S128, and all selection examples. Commit the manifest SHA first; evaluate only the already-frozen T25 checkpoint once. Use no per-anchor reveal or tuning.
next_test.recommended_source: previously untouched HotpotQA development remainder or an independently sourced held-out split
next_test.external_validity: Separately freeze MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA adapters and manifests before any model output is viewed.
